entries.en: to resemble in the face; to look alike in facial features
to be alike; to resemble
to be somewhat alike; to resemble slightly
to correspond; to match; to be alike in correspondence
of the same generation; peers; ranking alike
entries.notes: 西语栏作「对应、相符」，与「同辈」为同一词头下第二解，语义略有出入。

entries.en: on the whole; roughly; it seems (to me)
roughly; broadly speaking; approximately
entries.notes: 西语「por ma yo menor」疑为「por mayor o menor」（或多或少）之误植。

entries.en: about; approximately
to estimate roughly; to gauge by measure
entries.notes: 「量约」为估量、忖度之谓，词形罕见，释义由汉栏与音写互证而定。

entries.en: in my opinion; as I think
to weigh up; to deliberate and estimate
entries.notes: H 栏首字标 [疑:尙/相]，而 M 栏 chãg 与二字均不合、音近「酌」，姑以「酌量」为释，字形待核。

entries.en: narrow; cramped (tentative)
entries.notes: H 栏作「尙狹」而首字标疑，M 栏 chãg hiá 与「尙/相」不合，疑本作「仄狹/窄狹」，与西语「parecerle」义亦难衔接，故存疑。

entries.zh: 影见；依稀看见，仿佛见到
entries.en: to seem to see; to catch a glimpse of
entries.notes: 「影见」谓仿佛看见，属意译，与西语字面不完全对应。

entries.en: likewise; in the same way
entries.notes: H、M 二栏作「照样」，与西语栏「glorioso no ha cierto」不合，西语疑有讹夺，释义从汉栏。

entries.en: [original defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: H、M、R 三栏原稿空白，仅存西语「parece desta manera」（作此状貌），无汉字与音写可据。

entries.en: wall
wall; a section of wall
of the same kind or clan; alike, equal
entries.notes: H、M 作「宗」chòng，与「parejo（相等、齐平）」为引申而非直译；西语「S.」当为「significa」之省。

entries.en: lineage; clan; kin
entries.notes: 西语「de un dien te」疑为「de un deudo」（同一亲属）之讹；「S.」为「significa」之省。

entries.en: [original defective; gloss uncertain]
entries.notes: H、M、R 三栏原稿空白，仅存西语词头「parentela」（亲族），承上条而列，无汉字可据。
